captions.text: ☞ Dux: the subject in the bass, in the dotted French style.
☞ Soprano: the subject inverted and in diminution, notes halved.
☞ Alto: the subject in diminution, a stretto of three forms.
☞ Tenor: the answer, inverted and diminished.
☞ Alto: the subject at full length, on A.
☞ Tenor: the subject inverted, at full length.
☞ Stretto: inverted, diminished, then both at once.
☞ Stretto: two diminutions around the inversion in the alto.
☞ The last entry: the subject in diminution, in the alto.
